title: Neo Hook Manifest
description: Schema for Neo plugin hook manifests at plugins/<plugin>/hooks/hooks.json. Event keys use the canonical Copilot CLI camelCase form; each event also has a PascalCase alias (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, ...) that VS Code reads for the same event, mapping `bash` to osx/linux and `powershell` to windows. Declaring an event in both its camelCase and PascalCase form fires it twice and is rejected by scripts/validate-plugins.py. Note there is no lowercase `userPromptSubmit` or `stop` event — those are the PascalCase aliases mis-cased, and never fire.

version.description: Manifest schema version. Only version 1 is currently defined.

description.description: Short description of what the hooks in this manifest do.

hooks.description: Map of lifecycle event names to arrays of hook command entries.

type.description: Hook entry type. Only "command" is supported.

bash.description: Copilot CLI property mapped to the osx and linux commands. Use ${PLUGIN_ROOT} to locate plugin scripts, and guard the script's existence before invoking it (`s="${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/x.sh"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; "$s" event`) — preToolUse is fail-closed, so a path that doesn't resolve denies every tool call.

powershell.description: Copilot CLI property mapped to the windows command. Use $env:PLUGIN_ROOT (NOT ${PLUGIN_ROOT}) to locate plugin scripts — ${PLUGIN_ROOT} is PowerShell's own variable syntax and expands to empty. Guard the script's existence before invoking it (`$s = "$env:PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/scripts/x.ps1"; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $s)) { exit 0 }; & $s event`) — preToolUse is fail-closed, so a path that doesn't resolve denies every tool call.

windows.description: Windows-specific command override. VS Code-native property.

linux.description: Linux-specific command override. VS Code-native property.

osx.description: macOS-specific command override. VS Code-native property.

env.description: Additional environment variables for the command.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds. VS Code-native property (default 30).

timeoutSec.description: Timeout in seconds. Copilot CLI property.
